Reconnecting WebsiteChecker as the sole equivalent terminal is valid; do not simply remove transport and expose stale duplicate retry/body logic. Equivalent concise cleanup may keep the active migration or reconnect an equivalent single live implementation; no required Transport type, RetrySchedule object or module layout. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Deleting live shared checker, request, scheduler or cache behavior based only on proximity to dead code is insufficient.
